weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，你的心和想像力完美和諧。浪漫的聯繫可以為您的藝術事業帶來靈感。您充滿活力的創造力增強了您的魅力，讓您的愛人更加親近。擁抱這一天的情感豐富和美麗-這是一個閃耀的絕佳機會！
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, your heart and imagination are in perfect harmony. A romantic connection could spark a wave of inspiration for your artistic endeavors. Your vibrant creativity enhances your allure, drawing your beloved even closer. Embrace the emotional richness and beauty of this day—it's a wonderful opportunity to shine!

taurus.horoscope: 作為金牛座，你通常有一個基礎和務實的生活方式，但今天你可能會發現自己渴望一點奇思妙想。潛入浪漫或奇幻文學的迷人世界，因為它可以吸引你的想像力。你甚至可以考慮寫自己的故事！如果你正在處於一段關係中，你的伴侶可能會為晚上計劃一些令人愉快的事情。擁抱當天的喜悅！
taurus.horoscope_en: As a Taurus, you usually have a grounded and pragmatic approach to life, but today you may find yourself yearning for a bit of whimsy. Dive into the enchanting world of romance or fantasy literature, as it could captivate your imagination. You might even consider penning your own tale! If you're in a relationship, your partner may have something delightful planned for the evening. Embrace the joy of the day!

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座的老朋友今天可能會透過衷心的信件、電話或電子郵件與你聯絡，分享他們對你過去善良的感謝。這個手勢會讓你充滿溫暖和感情，促使你回報情緒。不妨邀請他們一起喝杯咖啡，享受深刻而有意義的對話。您分享的聯繫非常重要，也是您需要培養的聯繫。
gemini.horoscope_en: An old friend may reach out to you today, Gemini, through a heartfelt letter, phone call, or email, sharing their appreciation for your past kindness. This gesture will fill you with warmth and affection, prompting you to return the sentiment. Consider inviting them for a coffee date where you can enjoy a deep and meaningful conversation. The connection you share is significant, and it's one you’ll want to nurture.

cancer.horoscope: 癌症，如果您一直想著職業轉變，今天可能會為您帶來一些有趣的機會，也許來自同事。這可能是考慮過渡的最佳時機。跡象表明你的職業生涯有良好的進步。花點時間記下你的選項，並深入研究每個選項。你可能會在一些令人興奮的新路徑的邊緣！
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, if a career shift has been on your mind, today could bring some intriguing opportunities your way, perhaps from a coworker. This might be the perfect moment to consider a transition. Signs point to favorable advancements in your professional life. Take some time to jot down your options and delve into research on each. You could be on the brink of some thrilling new paths!

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你的心可能充滿了溫暖和感情，使浪漫成為一個突出的主題。您可能會覺得與遠方的伴侶建立聯繫的想法特別吸引人。這是一個理想的日子，與親密的朋友計劃一個舒適的夜晚，探索展開的可能性。星星建議你的朋友分享你的感受，你可能會發現自己正朝著你一直希望的方向前進！
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, your heart is likely to be overflowing with warmth and affection, making romance a prominent theme. You might find the idea of connecting with a partner from afar particularly enticing. It's an ideal day to plan a cozy evening with a close friend and explore the possibilities that unfold. The stars suggest that your friend shares your feelings, and you could find yourself heading in the direction you've been hoping for!

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，今天你可能會發現自己醒來時有一種奇特的氛圍，這要歸功於一些熱氣騰騰的夢想。雖然你可能渴望建立浪漫的聯繫，但這些夢想的影響可能超越單純的慾望。如果您還沒有參與專案，它們也可能激發您的創造力，導致創意激增。讓這些想法稍微冷靜一下；沒有必要匆忙做出決定。享受一天的樂趣！
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, you may find yourself waking up with a peculiar vibe today, thanks to some steamy dreams. While you might yearn for a romantic connection, the effects of these dreams could reach beyond mere desire. They may also ignite your creativity, leading to a surge of ideas if you're not already engaged in a project. Allow these thoughts to simmer for a bit; there's no need to rush into a decision. Take pleasure in your day!

libra.horoscope: 意想不到的轉折可能會讓你感到驚訝，因為老朋友對你表達了浪漫的感情。這項啟示可能會激起複雜的情緒，但如果你是單身，不要忽視這種可能性。這裡有機會建立有意義的聯繫。請記住，您不必急於做任何事情或完全忽略它。慢慢來探索這個新動態！
libra.horoscope_en: An unexpected twist may leave you surprised as an old friend expresses romantic feelings towards you. This revelation might stir up mixed emotions, but if you're single, don't dismiss the possibility. There’s a chance for a meaningful connection here. Remember, you don’t have to rush into anything or completely disregard it. Take your time to explore this new dynamic!

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，你可能會發現自己在聚光燈下，無論是向人羣發表演講還是促進討論。雖然你通常喜歡保持低調，但今天你會抓住機會並享受關注，即使只是一小段時間。你的魅力無疑會吸引你周圍的人，你可以期待你的努力得到真正的讚美。 活動結束後，請花點時間放鬆身心，好好品嚐當天剩餘的時間，這當然是你應得的！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, you might find yourself in the spotlight, whether it's addressing a crowd or facilitating a discussion. While you usually prefer to keep a low profile, today you'll embrace the opportunity and relish the attention, even if just for a short while. Your charisma will undoubtedly captivate those around you, and you can expect genuine praise for your efforts. Once the event wraps up, take some time to unwind and savor the rest of your day—you've certainly earned it!

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，今天對你來說是充滿浪漫的一天！你可能會覺得特別誘人，吸引崇拜者的注意力，即使是來自陌生的面孔。如果你獨自一人，一種令人興奮的新浪漫興趣可能會來到你身邊。對於處於一段關係中的人來說，你的伴侶可能會發現自己重新愛上了你。如果可以的話，一起計劃一個舒適的夜晚，品味這一刻！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today is a day of heightened romance for you, Sagittarius! You'll likely feel particularly alluring, drawing the attention of admirers, even from unfamiliar faces. If you're on your own, a thrilling new romantic interest could come your way. For those in a relationship, your partner may find themselves falling for you anew. If you can, plan a cozy evening together and savor the moment!
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天你可能會覺得自己像一百萬美元！財務事宜可能會超出您的預期，帶來豐富感。不妨考慮花一些時間整理您的生活空間，或為自己享受一點零售療法。如果你今晚和某個特別的人約會，一件調情的新衣服可能會引起他們的注意！隨著自信心的增強，你會發光發亮。 所以，穿上你最喜歡的顏色，享受這一天吧！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you might find yourself feeling like a million bucks! Financial matters are likely to exceed your expectations, bringing a sense of abundance. Consider dedicating some time to sprucing up your living space or indulging in a little retail therapy for yourself. If you have a date with someone special this evening, a flirty new outfit could really catch their eye! With your boosted self-confidence, you’ll shine even brighter. So, don your favorite colors and enjoy the day!

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，你可能會遇到一個吸引你眼球的迷人陌生人。您可能會覺得不得不自我介紹，從而發現不僅是物理化學，還有共同的智力聯繫。看來你的興趣很可能是相互的！如果你目前是單身，這個火種可能值得進一步探索。如果你處於一段關係中，你仍然可以獲得寶貴的新友誼。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, you may encounter a captivating stranger who catches your eye. You might feel compelled to introduce yourself, leading to a delightful discovery of not just physical chemistry but also a shared intellectual connection. It seems your interest is likely mutual! If you're currently single, this spark could be worth exploring further. If you're in a relationship, you could still gain a valuable new friendship.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，你的專業和財務前景看起來很光明，你的浪漫生活也可能會蓬勃發展。雖然其他人可能會欽佩你的生活，但你可能會覺得還缺少一些東西。今天是深入研究形而上學和靈性追求的絕佳機會。當您經歷這段變革時期時，探索這些興趣可以為您提供安慰，特別是如果您的親人處於相同的波段。
pisces.horoscope_en: Your professional and financial prospects are looking bright, Pisces, and your romantic life may be flourishing as well. While others might admire your life, you may sense that something is still lacking. Today is an excellent opportunity to delve into metaphysical and spiritual pursuits. As you navigate this period of change, exploring these interests can provide you with comfort, especially if your loved ones are on the same wavelength.
